title: fix(image): forward every reference image MAI and xAI accept
author: Saauf

gist.summary: MAI Image 2.6, MAI Image 2.6 Flash, and xAI Grok Imagine now receive up to 5 reference images instead of only the first; OpenRouter’s Grok Imagine Pro receives up to 3. MAI billing uses Azure-reported image tokens, while input-image charges are 0.002 per image for xAI Grok Imagine and 0.01055 per image for OpenRouter Grok Imagine Pro. A shared request check replaces adapter-level truncation: requests above a model’s maxReferenceImages return a 400 with the supported limit before a provider call. Seedream 5.0 Flash retains its 10-image limit. Fallback routes are unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden studio, Polli carefully arranges several little reference pictures beside a glowing lime green (#ecf874) image-making terminal, while a small sign marks the picture limit and code-plants bloom nearby. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny artist glasses and stays small within the scene. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
